name: Kitchen Remodel Timelines: What Affects Your Project Schedule

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Design Planning
step.text: This phase kicks off with assessing your existing space, establishing your functional requirements, and defining your budget. This is where your vision takes shape through CAD-supported layouts and material selections. This step typically involves several meetings and revisions, ensuring every detail aligns with your dreams for enhancing functionality, beauty, and value. It often takes several weeks to get this just right, as thorough planning prevents costly changes later.

step.name: Step 2: Permit Coordination and Material Ordering
step.text: Once the design is finalized, permits need to be secured, especially if your modernization involves changes to electrical, plumbing, gas, or structural elements. This can take anywhere from a few weeks to a couple of months, depending on local DFW jurisdiction requirements. Simultaneously, long-lead items like custom cabinetry, specialty appliances, or unique flooring are ordered. Making material selections and placing orders before demolition is key to preventing delays down the road.
